description: The five kinds of listing in IutGotGan, the neighbourhood trading app: producer sales, direct trade, swap and barter, garage sales, and free giveaways. Returns each category's id, its title in the requested language and its emoji. Individual listings are not available here — they carry people's locations.

lang.description: Response language: ar, en, es, fr, ko, pt. Default en.

name: iutgotgan_list_categories
title: List IutGotGan listing categories
